propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI
FastMCP derives JSON schemas from handwritten callable signatures and discards undeclared payload keys before adapter execution
The MCP adapter forwarding layer independently drops the same parameters (only close_class for transition, only assignee for claim), so signature changes alone would still lose them
Operator ruling 2026-08-18 rescinds the force-denial policy and mandates lib/CLI/MCP parity with absent certification as the audit signal
Integration tests confirm the root cause: live schemas omit all reported fields, real MCP capture receives only current kwargs, and library produces edges/refs that MCP currently loses
